rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.e1: Attack: the pawn is on g5, with your king right behind it, on g4. Your rook, on f1, cuts off the black king on the e-file.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.e2: The plan is to escort the pawn: bring the king right next to it up to the front. But h5 is covered by the black rook, and on f5 the king blocks your rook. How do you start?
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.p: Attack: think and suggest a move, or tap {verResposta}
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.certo: Attack: the pawn advances to g6 and frees the g5 square for your king to climb right next to it.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.revela: Attack: the plan is to advance the pawn to g6, to free the g5 square for your king.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.fora: That move is not one of those we are studying here. Let us go back to the position.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.volta: Let us go back to the position. Suggest another move or tap {verResposta}
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.alt.f1f3.1: Attack: this also wins: on f3, the rook keeps cutting off the black king. But your king still has nowhere to climb, and the pawn advance opens that square.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.alt.f1f3.2: Attack: now let us go to the main line, with the pawn advance.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.alt.f1f4.1: Attack: this also wins: on f4, the rook keeps cutting off the black king. But your king still has nowhere to climb, and the pawn advance opens that square.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.alt.f1f4.2: Attack: now let us go to the main line, with the pawn advance.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.alt.f1f5.1: Attack: this also wins: on f5, the rook keeps cutting off the black king. But your king still has nowhere to climb, and the pawn advance opens that square.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.alt.f1f5.2: Attack: now let us go to the main line, with the pawn advance.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.alt.f1f6.1: Attack: this also wins: on f6, the rook keeps cutting off the black king. But your king still has nowhere to climb, and the pawn advance opens that square.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.alt.f1f6.2: Attack: now let us go to the main line, with the pawn advance.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.f1a1.1: Attack: the rook goes to a1, leaves the f-file and stops cutting off the black king.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.f1a1.2: Defense: Black finds a resource: the black king steps to f7, from where it watches g6, the square in front of the pawn, and holds the draw.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.f1b1.1: Attack: the rook goes to b1, leaves the f-file and stops cutting off the black king.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.f1b1.2: Defense: Black finds a resource: the black king steps to f7, from where it watches g6, the square in front of the pawn, and holds the draw.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.f1c1.1: Attack: the rook goes to c1, leaves the f-file and stops cutting off the black king.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.f1c1.2: Defense: Black finds a resource: the black king steps to f7, from where it watches g6, the square in front of the pawn, and holds the draw.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.f1d1.1: Attack: the rook goes to d1, leaves the f-file and stops cutting off the black king.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.f1d1.2: Defense: Black finds a resource: the black king steps to f7, from where it watches g6, the square in front of the pawn, and holds the draw.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.f1g1.1: Attack: the rook goes to g1, leaves the f-file and stops cutting off the black king.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.f1g1.2: Defense: Black finds a resource: the black king steps to f7, from where it watches g6, the square in front of the pawn, and holds the draw.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.f1e1.1: Attack: the rook checks on e1, but it leaves the f-file and stops cutting off the black king.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.f1e1.2: Defense: Black finds a resource: the black king escapes the check to f7, from where it watches g6, the square in front of the pawn, and holds the draw.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.g4f3.1: Attack: the king retreats to f3, away from the pawn, and leaves it unprotected.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.g4f3.2: Defense: Black finds a resource: the black rook moves to h8, from where it will attack the unprotected pawn: a draw.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.g4g3.1: Attack: the king retreats to g3, away from the pawn, and leaves it unprotected.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.g4g3.2: Defense: Black finds a resource: the black rook moves to h8, from where it will attack the unprotected pawn: a draw.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.g4f4.1: Attack: the king goes to f4, next to the pawn, but it does not open a path for the pawn to advance.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.g4f4.2: Defense: Black finds a resource: the black rook goes to g2 and attacks the pawn from behind. Your king is tied to it: a draw.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.g4f5.1: Attack: the king goes to f5, on your rook's file, and blocks its path.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.g4f5.2: Defense: Black finds a resource: with the f-file blocked, the black king steps to f7, from where it watches g6, the square in front of the pawn, and holds the draw.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.f1f8.1: Attack: the rook goes to f8, next to the black king and unprotected.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.f1f8.2: Defense: Black finds a resource: the black king captures the rook, and rook against pawn is a win for Black.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.f1f7.1: Attack: the rook checks on f7, but it stands next to the black king, unprotected.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.f1f7.2: Defense: Black finds a resource: the black king captures the rook, and rook against pawn is a win for Black.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.f1h1.1: Attack: the rook goes to h1, on the black rook's file and unprotected.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.f1h1.2: Defense: Black finds a resource: the black rook captures yours, and rook against pawn is a win for Black.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.f1f2.1: Attack: the rook goes to f2, on the black rook's rank and unprotected.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.err.f1f2.2: Defense: Black finds a resource: the black rook captures yours, and rook against pawn is a win for Black.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.l0: Attack: with the pawn on g6, your king has g5 to climb. Watch how it escorts the pawn: it climbs right next to it and never leaves it alone.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.l1: Defense: the black rook checks along the g-file, from behind the pawn.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.l2: Attack: the king goes to h5, the only square that wins: right next to the pawn, it protects it. On f5, it would block your rook's file.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.l3: Defense: the black rook switches files and checks along the h-file.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.l4: Attack: the king goes back to g5, behind the pawn. It does not run far away: it always stays next to the pawn.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.l5: Defense: again the check along the g-file.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.l6: Attack: now the king climbs to h6, next to the pawn, and gains a rank.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.l7: Defense: the black rook checks along the h-file again.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.l8: Attack: the king steps in front of the pawn, to g7. On the g-file, the pawn stands between it and the black rook and shields it from checks from below.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.l9: Defense: with no checks, the black rook attacks the pawn from behind, along the g-file.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.l10: Attack: the king goes to h7 and keeps protecting the pawn. On g8 or h8, it would leave the pawn unprotected.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.l11: Defense: the black rook checks along the h-file.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.l12: Attack: the king goes to g8, in front of the pawn. Now the black rook is on the h-file and does not attack the pawn: it is unprotected for one move, but it advances to g7 first. Along the g-file, there are no more checks.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.l13: Defense: with no checks along the g-file, the black rook goes far away, to the a-file, to check from the side.
rot.chegar.ideia.ex1.l14: Attack: the pawn reaches the seventh rank, with the king in front of it: this is the Lucena position. Now come the check that drives the black king away and the bridge.
rot.chegar.demos.outroLado.1: Attack: now on the other side of the board. The pawn is on c6, your king on b5, and the rook cuts off the black king on the d-file. Watch the escort.
rot.chegar.demos.outroLado.2: Attack: the king climbs to b6, right next to the pawn.
rot.chegar.demos.outroLado.3: Defense: the black rook checks along the b-file.
rot.chegar.demos.outroLado.4: Attack: the king steps in front of the pawn, to c7. Along the c-file, the black rook cannot check: the pawn is in the way.
rot.chegar.demos.outroLado.5: Defense: the black rook attacks the pawn from behind, but your king protects it.
rot.chegar.demos.outroLado.6: Attack: the king goes to b7 and stays next to the pawn.
rot.chegar.demos.outroLado.7: Defense: the black rook checks along the b-file.
rot.chegar.demos.outroLado.8: Attack: the king enters c8, the promotion square. The pawn is unprotected for one move, but it advances before it can be captured.
rot.chegar.demos.outroLado.9: Defense: the black rook attacks the pawn from behind.
rot.chegar.demos.outroLado.10: Attack: the pawn advances to c7, with the king in front of it: this is the Lucena position, and the bridge does the rest.
rot.chegar.demos.tapar.1: Defense: now you play Black. White brought the king to f4 instead of advancing the pawn. Watch how Black holds the draw.
rot.chegar.demos.tapar.2: Defense: the black rook goes to g2 and attacks the pawn from behind: it is the only move that holds the draw. The white king is tied to the pawn.
rot.chegar.demos.tapar.3: Attack: the white king tries to climb via f5, but, tied to the pawn and on its own rook's file, it no longer wins.
rot.chegar.demos.tapar.4: Defense: with the f-file blocked, the black king comes to f7, from where it watches g6, the square in front of the pawn: a draw.
rot.chegar.pratica.escolta.p: Attack: White again. The pawn is on e5, with your king behind it, and the rook cuts off the black king on the d-file. Escort the pawn and promote.
rot.chegar.pratica.escolta.fim: The pawn promoted: you escorted it to the Lucena position and built the bridge.
rot.chegar.pratica.fins.afogado: The black king is stalemated: a draw. Before each move, check that Black still has a move.
rot.chegar.pratica.fins.repeticao: The same position came up three times: a draw. Instead of running from the checks, climb with the king right next to the pawn.
rot.chegar.pratica.fins.limite: The practice time ran out before the pawn promoted. Climb with the king right next to the pawn and, in the Lucena position, build the bridge.
rot.chegar.pratica.fins.insuficiente: The rook and the pawn left the board, and the material is not enough: a draw. Keep the pawn and the rook protected until promotion.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.corte.1: The rook left the d-file and stopped cutting off the black king: it crosses over near the pawn, and it is a draw.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.corte.2: Keep the rook on the d-file, cutting off the black king, until it is time for the bridge.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.tapa.1: Your king stepped onto the d-file and blocked your rook: the black king is no longer cut off, and the win slipped away.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.tapa.2: Climb with the king on the side of the pawn away from the rook, without stepping onto its file.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.longe.1: Your king went to a square far from the pawn instead of climbing right next to it, and the win slipped away: a draw.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.longe.2: During the escort, the king always stays next to the pawn or in front of it.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.presa.1: The rook went close to the black king and is protected only by your king: tied to it, your king stops escorting the pawn, and it is a draw.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.presa.2: Keep the rook far from the black king, on the d-file, so your king stays free.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.perto.1: The rook went close to the black king, unprotected: the king attacks it and gains time to cross the d-file, and it is a draw.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.perto.2: Keep the rook far from the black king, at the bottom of the d-file.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.cedo.1: The pawn advanced too early: your king cannot protect it on its new square, the black rook attacks it, and it is a draw.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.cedo.2: Before advancing the pawn, check that your king can protect it on its new square before the black rook gets there.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.peao.1: The pawn is unprotected, within reach of the black rook, and the win slipped away.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.peao.2: Keep the king next to the pawn, or in front of it, until the Lucena position.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.torre.1: The rook went to a square within reach of the black rook: it captures it or forces the trade, and with the pawn alone the win slips away.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.torre.2: Before each rook move, check whether the new square is within reach of the black rook.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.rei.1: The rook went close to the black king, where Black attacks it, and the win slipped away.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.rei.2: Keep the rook far from the black king, where it cannot reach it.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.coroa.1: The pawn promoted on a square within reach of the black rook: it captures the new piece, and rook against rook is a draw.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.coroa.2: Before promoting, check whether the black rook reaches the promotion square. If it does, build the bridge first.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.menor.1: The pawn became a bishop or a knight, and rook and minor piece against rook is usually a draw.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.pendurada.1: The black rook was attacking your rook, and the king move did not save it: Black captures it, and with the pawn alone there is no win.
rot.chegar.pratica.err.pendurada.2: Before each move, check whether the black rook attacks yours. If it does, take care of it first.
